本轮过程记录

Verify-repair round 2: the ticket feature (pages, routes, server endpoints, authorization composites, permission sets, demo users, sample tickets) was implemented on top of the pre-existing it_tickets migration and the app was exercised end-to-end against a real server. Server-side enforcement (own-record isolation, handler-only start/complete, transition conflicts, resolution required, status filter) and deep-link isolation all verified with the seeded accounts; full test suite (307), lint, prettier and the three tsconfig typechecks pass, and db apply seeds a clean database.

问题 01 · implement

Source-checkout seeds could not resolve their relative TypeScript siblings

本任务已处理

AppDatabaseTaskError: Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from '.../database/main/seeds/202609210001_it_tickets_permission_sets.ts' while running the app-server/vitest source path.

原因（实现者自述）
The task loader appends a ?mtime= query before calling __rewriteRelativeImportExtension, so a relative './x.js' specifier is imported verbatim; Node's native type stripping then cannot map it onto the existing x.ts file. The CLI's tsx loader masks this in the source checkout, but the standalone app-server runtime does not register tsx.
处理方式
Seed and seed-data files import their TypeScript siblings with an explicit .ts extension; the server tsconfig chain enables allowImportingTsExtensions + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, so tsc emits .js again for dist. Verified the emitted dist files contain the rewritten .js specifiers.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · implement

Application provider boot crashed in runtimes without the authorization plugin

本任务已处理

Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered during the app-server runtime test that assembles a plugin-free runtime.

原因（实现者自述）
ItTicketsProvider.boot() resolved authorizationToken unconditionally, but the token only exists when the authorization plugin registered its provider.
处理方式
boot() returns early when the container has no authorizationToken, and each registration is guarded for idempotency. Providers are only reachable through a runtime that mounts the plugin.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · implement

Creating a ticket failed with 500 on a create-only database policy

本任务已处理

POST /api/it-tickets returned 500; RepositoryError: Reading from this Repository is forbidden by Policy, from createOne -> readContext.

原因（实现者自述）
Repository.createOne resolves the read side of the policy to pick and return the created row. A defineDatabasePermission that declared .create() but no .read() produced a policy whose read was denied.
处理方式
Added .read(READ_FIELDS) to the create grant so the same action may return the row it created; re-verified create as an employee returns 201 and the new row appears only in that employee's list.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · implement

New client effects, seed destructuring and a redundant type intersection failed lint

本任务已处理

eslint --max-warnings 0 reported set-state-in-effect errors/warnings, an unbound-method error for a destructured seed-context method, and no-redundant-type-constituents for 'keyof T & string'.

原因（实现者自述）
Synchronous setState at the top of a useEffect body; destructuring SeedContext.repository (a method) before calling it; and string already implied by every key of the record type.
处理方式
Moved the loading flag updates into event handlers and async callbacks, inlined the detail fetch into its effect, read the seed repository through context.repository(...), and dropped the redundant '& string'. Lint is clean for every changed file.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · documentation

Authorization Skill does not state that a create grant needs read to return its row

需人工判断

A business operation that creates a record through Repository.createOne silently gets a 500 (Reading from this Repository is forbidden by Policy) unless the same DatabasePermission also declares .read(). The fluent-registration example only shows read and update grants, so the required read on a create path is easy to miss.

建议改动

Add a sentence to the authorization fluent-registration/runtime-api references: a create grant must also include the read fields it returns, because the Repository reads the created row back under the same policy.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · 工具与构建

react-hooks/set-state-in-effect flags async reload helpers inconsistently

可自动化

Inlining a promise chain with block-bodied .then/.catch/.finally callbacks in the effect is accepted, while extracting the same logic into a useCallback and calling it (or using async/await) is reported as an error even when the first setState happens after an await. This nudges authors toward duplicating load logic instead of a reusable callback.

建议改动

Document the accepted effect-fetch pattern in the application development frontend reference (inline promise chain, active guard, setState only in callbacks; reload via an event-handler-incremented revision), so new pages pass pnpm lint without trial and error.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · process

Run prettier and eslint on generated source before the verification handoff

可自动化

Several newly written files were not Prettier-formatted and carried lint errors, so the first pass at a fresh check fails on style rather than behaviour. The repairs were mechanical but consumed a full cycle.

建议改动

Have the implement step run the repository's fix/format scripts on the files it touched before finishing, or add a pre-handoff format+lint gate over changed paths.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · 工具与构建

Seed checksum warnings after any seed edit

需人工判断

Editing a seed after it has run makes db apply warn that the recorded checksum no longer matches, which is noise on an otherwise healthy run and can hide a real mismatch.

建议改动

When a repair edits only comments or formatting of an already-applied seed, prefer recreating the local database (delete the sqlite file and db apply) over reading past the warning, and note that the deployment path is unaffected.

来源：Agent · retro.json
